sentences.text:
---------
Dinashit Kongari ... ... ... Petitioner Vrs.
State of Jharkhand ... ... ... Respondents

Coram : Sri Ananda Sen, J
---------
For the Petitioner: Mr. Vishal Kumar Rai, Advocate For the State : Mr. Praful Jojo, Advocate
02/Dated: 19.06.2023
Counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to implead opposite party no.2 in the cause-title.
Necessary correction to be carried out during course of the day.
Issue notice to the opposite no.2 by both process, for which requisites etc, under registered process as well as through ordinary process must be filed within one week.
The petitioner, who is an accused for the offence punishable under Sections, 376, 323, 417 of the IPC, is praying for grant of regular bail.
Heard the learned counsel for the Parties.

Considering the nature of allegation, I am inclined to allow provisional bail to the petitioner to be released on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned CJM, Khunti in connection with Khunti (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 23 of 2022, corresponding to G.R.
No. 190 of 2023.
Petitioner is directed to appear before the Registrar Civil Court, Khunti once in every month till disposal of this bail application.
